title: Barrier spells (potency notes)

subjects.name: Barrier spells
subjects.runtime_id: 87 Holy Armor, 88 Holy Bulwark, 235 Corpse Shield, 252 Divine Aegis, 488 Mental Barrier

problem: The bug: the Enchanter offers Moonstone ('Damage Increased By X%') on these gems, because its compatibility test looks for the words 'amount of damage' in the English description ('absorbs a massive amount of damage'); the spells deal no damage, so the property does nothing. In other languages the test falls back to the category tag and the property is not offered.
notes: Text: Holy Armor: "Target gains a {CONDNAME_BUFF_BARRIER} that absorbs a massive amount of damage." | Moonstone: "Damage Increased By {1}%" / "The spell deals additional damage." | ... Evidence: spell_signatures: Holy Armor / Holy Bulwark / Corpse Shield / Divine Aegis / Mental Barrier -> bc_SpellHealing + bc_EventBuff(Barrier); scr_FixSpellGemProps 0x1460a8080 c10 = desc has "amount of damage" (spell_property_compat.json _note); effective column 10 = 1 for all five. Fix sketch: Post-init hook after scr_FixSpellGemProps (or a hook on inv_SpellGemCanHaveProperty) that clears spell[id][10] for ids 87, 88, 235, 252, 488 (and any other non-damaging spell the 'amount of damage' substring catches), so Moonstone is no longer offered. Gems already holding Moonstone keep an inert property. Reasoning: The codex promises incompatible properties can't be enchanted; a substring slip in the English description test offers one anyway. App note (unpatched game): Barrier spells scale like healing spells (healing tiers and spell-healing bonuses), and the Damage Increased property does nothing on them. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
